新增:
视频播放
视频在单独的播放页打开，可调节播放速度、保存到相册，也可缩成小窗边看边逛；小窗可拖到任意角落，离开应用时可自动转为小窗

提取文字
看图时可识别图片中的文字，选中后复制

自动打码与点选打码
编辑图片时，一键找出手机号、身份证号、银行卡号、邮箱、车牌、二维码等信息并打码；也可点按要遮住的内容，或按住滑过一次遮住多处

图片编辑新工具
新增拉直、调节与擦除；已画的标注和打码可再选中修改；裁剪支持常用比例

隐私
可查看黑名单与推荐中屏蔽的吧，并移出或取消屏蔽

隐藏 IP 属地
可不显示楼层与个人主页上的 IP 属地

楼中楼排序
楼中楼可按「热门」或「最早」排序，热门顺序与楼层下显示的一致

左右滑动切换页面
首页、动态、消息与「我」之间可左右滑动切换，可在设置中关闭

存储空间
查看应用占用的空间，按类别清除缓存，管理智能扩展
改进:
图片更清晰
上传的图片保持原有清晰度与方向，长截图不再被压成细条；看图时显示广色域与 HDR 色彩

视频更好用
列表中显示视频时长；无法播放时可重试；来电、拔出耳机或离开应用时自动暂停

看图界面更通透
看图与看视频时，按钮改为玻璃样式

推荐中的回复
推荐中出现的回复，在原帖中打开对应楼层

加载状态更明确
消息、热门与话题页在首次加载、出错或没有内容时都有提示；没有网络时提示「无法连接网络」

再点一次刷新
在消息页再点一次底栏即可刷新

纯色材质更清爽
关闭毛玻璃后，顶栏淡淡透出下方的内容，悬浮按钮不再带阴影

界面更整齐
顶栏按钮与页面内容左右对齐，圆角与胶囊的过渡更顺滑

按压效果更统一
按住顶部标签与分段控件时，与底栏的效果一致

滑动更流畅
减少滑动与打开搜索时的卡顿

回复面板
图片缩略图更大，删除按钮更容易点按

回复框展开后收起键盘，显示异常
多次复制后无法复制，也无法返回
帖子回复加载失败时显示为已到底部

楼中楼页未使用「经典」样式

宽图打开时未完整显示

New:
Video player
Videos open in a player of their own: change the speed, save to the gallery, or shrink to picture in picture and keep browsing. Drag the window to any corner; it can take over when you leave the app

Extract text
Read the text in a picture while viewing it, then select and copy it

Auto masking and tap to mask
When editing a picture, mask phone, ID and bank card numbers, emails, number plates, QR codes and more in one step; or tap what to cover, or hold and slide over several things at once

New editing tools
Straighten, Adjust and Erase; pick up a mark or mask again to change it; crop to common ratios

Privacy
See your blacklist and the forums hidden from For you, and remove or unhide them

Hide IP location
Leave IP locations off replies and profiles

Comment order
Sort comments by Top or Oldest; Top matches the comments shown under a reply

Swipe between tabs
Swipe between Home, Explore, Inbox and Me; turn it off in Settings

Storage
See what the app takes up, clear its cache by kind and manage smart extensions
Improved:
Sharper pictures
Uploaded pictures keep their sharpness and orientation, and long screenshots no longer shrink to a strip; the viewer shows wide colour and HDR

Better videos
Lists show how long a video runs; retry a video that can't play; videos pause for calls, unplugged headphones and leaving the app

Clearer viewers
The picture and video viewers' buttons are now glass

Replies in For you
A reply recommended to you opens at its reply in the thread

Clearer loading
Inbox, Hot and topic pages say when they are loading, fail or have nothing to show; without a network they say Can't connect

Tap again to refresh
Tap Inbox in the bottom bar again to refresh it

Cleaner solid material
With blur off, content shows faintly under the top bar, and floating buttons cast no shadow

Tidier layout
Top bar buttons line up with the page's content, and corners and capsules round off more smoothly

Consistent press feedback
Holding the top tabs or a segmented control feels like the bottom bar

Smoother scrolling
Less stutter while scrolling and opening search

Reply panel
Larger picture thumbnails with an easier remove button
